title: 2023 Panini Select DK Metcalf Black And Green Premier Die Cut #170 Seahawks
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
This 2023 Panini Select trading card features DK Metcalf of the Seattle Seahawks in a black and green premier die cut design. The card is made of high-quality card stock material and is an original print from the United States. It is a standard size sports trading card that is perfect for any collection.

This card is a must-have for any NFL fan or collector, especially those who admire DK Metcalf's skills on the field. It is a great addition to any collection and is sure to stand out with its unique die-cut design. Don't miss out on the opportunity to own this 2023 Panini Select trading card.
